text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[TS] trait: Cost 4

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
＜Raid＞ ＜Alliance＞ ＜Engage＞ (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack.)
[When Digivolving] Add your top security card to the hand. Then, if it's your turn, you may play or use 1 [Iliad] or [TS] trait card from your hand with the cost reduced by 5.
[All Turns] When any of your [TS] trait Digimon or Tamers would leave the battle area, by placing this Digimon's top stacked card as the bottom security card, they don't leave.

text_sections.label: DUAL Effect
text_sections.text:
For each of your security cards, add 1 to this card's use cost.
＜Use Req. ([TS] trait)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)
[Main] Delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP. Then, ＜Recovery +1＞.

text_sections.label: DUAL Rule
text_sections.text: ＜Arts Digivolve＞ (Instead of trashing after use, your cards may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)

qa.answer:
Yes, the play cost will be reduced by a total of 10.
Related Cards
qa.question: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to play [BT25-044 Junomon], can I activate [BT25-044 Junomon]'s 1st effect and reduce the play cost by a total of 10?

qa.answer:
This effect triggers and can be activated when a Digimon or Tamer specified by it leaves the battle area under the specified conditions.
When activated, all Digimon and Tamers matching its trigger conditions are prevented from leaving.
qa.question: What does this card's [All Turns] effect do, exactly?

qa.answer:
Yes, it is always active.
The use cost is constantly fluctuating, and the card is referenced as an Option card with that cost.
qa.question: Is Wide Plasment's first effect always active?
